content: Grand Theft Auto 6 has a giant crab haunting the swamps and, more importantly, the Crabshack VF5 SMG, a crab-themed gun, to help your future career prospects. It's all part of an optional event called Pelican Valley Outpost that sees you pick up the pieces of some questionable experiments carried out on behalf of a store chain. It's worth the trouble, even aside from the standout weapon. There's some cash to help reach your next family fund milestone and a free jet ski, too. Best of all, this little excursion is completely safe, assuming you don't run afoul of the local gator population.
